summary.value: A complete local CKEditor AI environment in Docker Compose: every backend service, your own LLM hookup, and MCP tool registration - the hands-on setup behind my on-premises webinar and Shorts.

content.value:
What's inside

A Docker Compose environment that runs the whole CKEditor AI on-premises stack locally: the AI service, its databases, and a CKEditor frontend wired to it. Bring your On-Premises trial credentials, point it at your own LLM, register MCP tools, and you have the full data-never-leaves-the-building setup on your laptop.

Why it exists

The demo environment behind the \"CKEditor AI on Your Premises\" webinar and the on-prem Shorts series - built so that evaluating the on-premises deployment model takes an afternoon, not a procurement cycle.
